icons.label: Grain direction
icons.meaning: A two-ended arrow for a documented reference direction.

icons.label: Fold edge
icons.meaning: A boundary line with two arrows pointing towards it.

icons.label: Single alignment mark
icons.meaning: One V-shaped alignment mark against a reference edge.

icons.label: Double alignment mark
icons.meaning: Two V-shaped alignment marks against a reference edge.

icons.label: Centre reference
icons.meaning: A dashed reference axis and a short transverse centre mark.

icons.label: Seam offset
icons.meaning: Two parallel angular paths with a perpendicular distance indicator.

icons.label: Cut edge
icons.meaning: A continuous angular outline used with an explicit cut-edge label.

icons.label: Stitch path
icons.meaning: A dashed curved path with distinct start and end markers.

icons.label: Drill reference
icons.meaning: A circular reference target; not a safe drilling instruction.

icons.label: Pleat pair
icons.meaning: A pair of fold references with arrows directed toward the middle.

icons.label: Button position
icons.meaning: A circular button position with two hole references.

icons.label: Reference square
icons.meaning: An uncalibrated square and side indicators for a labelled reference feature.
